surroundingContext:
The Roman Colosseum was a large amphitheater in ancient Rome. Its layered seating, repeated arches, internal passages, and arena floor made it a complex public structure. Understanding it spatially requires more than viewing the outside.

A good SPATAIL scene should combine a miniature overview with a cutaway. The learner can first understand the full shape, then inspect layers and movement paths inside the structure.
learningGoal: Explain the structure as a layered architectural and historical space.
spatailPrompt:

Prefer a guided tour with labeled phases, progressive reveal, and interactive controls (step through, tap to highlight, isolate parts, reset). Its layered seating, repeated arches, internal passages, and arena floor made it a complex public structure. Understanding it spatially requires more than viewing the outside.

A good SPATAIL scene should combine a miniature overview with a cutaway. The learner can first understand the full shape, then inspect layers and movement paths ".
